text:
Alyssa: Quick sync — we want to run a CTR experiment on the launch post SERP snippet before the webinar. thinking 3 meta variants + 1 structured-data push. goal: 8% lift in CTR.
Mike: love it. what pages are in scope?
Alyssa: primary: /blog/launch-productx, secondary: webinar landing + benchmark narrative page. need keywords mapped to each.
Sara: I can pull the KW map today. suggest top intent clusters: 'product x latency', 'product x cost comparison', 'how product x works'.
Devon: tagging & redirects question — are we going to change canonical or use redirect rules for the landing CTA variants?
Alyssa: prefer to keep canonical stable. we'll use query-string variants for snippet A/B and server-side redirects only if we change paths. avoid permanent redirects during experiment.
Mike: instrumentation checklist: GA4 event for snippet_click, UTM campaign for snippet_variant, server logs + Search Console impression join. anyone add to that?
Sara: add an internal link heatmap update. want to push more internal links from docs to the benchmark narrative to help ranking pre-experiment.
Devon: noted. I'll add a short snippet to the docs template. also will update sitemap ping once the schema changes go live.
Alyssa: schema plan: add Article structured data on launch post, FAQ schema on webinar landing, and breadcrumb schema on benchmark narrative. seo-bot you cool to run a quick validation when ready?
seo-bot: sure — will validate JSON-LD and flag missing fields. I can also run a snippet preview for mobile/desktop previews.
Mike: meta variants draft (short):
- V1: "Product X — Faster inference, lower cost. Join our launch webinar for benchmarks."
- V2: "See Product X benchmarks: latency, cost, and real-world examples. Webinar + report."
- V3: "Why Product X changes inference economics — live webinar + deep-dive report."
Alyssa: nice. Sara can you write one more benefit-led OA variant?
Sara: OA: "Cut inference costs without losing quality — Product X benchmarks & live demo. Register now."
Devon: for the server-side A/B we'll serve meta by cookie. simple nginx snippet: 
```
map $cookie_snip to_meta {
  default v1;
  "variant_b" v2;
}
add_header X-Snippet $to_meta;
```
Devon: I'll add a staging test route first.
Mike: redirects checklist for later: maintain old campaign UTM paths, add 302s for experiment links, review vanity shortlinks. don't do 301s yet.
Alyssa: internal linking tasks: 1) add contextual link from docs 'inference tuning' to benchmark narrative, 2) update primary nav to include webinar teaser for 2 weeks, 3) canonicalize blog series pages.
Sara: I'll update the KW spreadsheet and drop it into /marketing/seo/board. leaving notes on intent and suggested meta variants.
Devon: timeline?
Alyssa: KW map + meta copy by EOD today, staging schema + snippet server tests by tomorrow noon, instrumentation deployed by EOD tomorrow. Webinar promo live within 48 hours after tests green.
Mike: I'll own analytics and the Search Console reconciliation. will post a short runbook in the thread once GA4 events are live.
Sara: sounds good — I'll ping when the KW sheet is up.
Alyssa: thanks team :rocket: — pls react with :thumbsup: when you've picked up tasks.
Devon: picked up (adds :eyes:).
seo-bot: Reminder: when you push schema, run schema validator and the AMP/structured data tester. I'll post results here. (scheduled at 3478901800)
